text:
oncall_bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: spike in 502/504s at api-gateway-edge (region: us-east-1). Error rate ~7% across edge nodes. Paging @alex_sre and @pagerduty.

alex_sre: I'm on it. Thanks. Is there a linked incident channel or runbook?

ana_support: I'm already seeing inbound tickets from a couple of customers reporting 502s in the last 10m. Triage: mobile + web clients affected, some retries succeed.

jay_runtime: Looking at the dashboard — gateway 5xxs started ~1887654100, spike peaked at 7.3% around 1887654200. Downstream services (api-core) 200s look fine; upstream timeout logs show `upstream prematurely closed connection`.

lee_infra: No infra deploys in the last 30m from infra side. Checking LB health — 3 edge workers reporting increased conn resets.

deploy_bot: No code deploys to edge or gateway in the last 60m. Recent config change flagged: rate-limit rule update ~1887653000 but rollout completed earlier.

alex_sre: Ok, first hypothesis: transient connection churn between edge proxy and gateway instances (TCP resets). Mitigations to try in parallel: 1) enable additional gateway replicas (scale +1), 2) temporarily route a portion of traffic to standby region (us-west-2), 3) flip the gateway circuit-breaker to 90% fail-open for non-critical routes, 4) increase upstream timeouts.

jay_runtime: I'm going to scale the gateway pool now (requested autoscaler +2). Pushing a config to bump keepalive and timeouts on the edge proxy for 10m window.

lee_infra: Rolling a small restart for the three affected edge instances to clear connection queues. Doing 1 node at a time.

ana_support: Noted. I'll notify customers on the ticket queue that we're investigating and to expect intermittent 502 errors; collecting affected request ids.

alex_sre: Also enabling partial traffic failover: route 20% traffic of the api-gateway-edge to us-west-2 to reduce load on the affected pool. Doing this as a canary.

jay_runtime: Scale request accepted, new pods coming up. I increased keepalive to 75s and upstream timeout to 45s in the edge config; reloading now.

oncall_bot: Action log: alex_sre initiated traffic split -> us-west-2 (20%), jay_runtime updated edge timeouts, lee_infra restarted 1/3 edge nodes, autoscaler +2 requested.

alex_sre: After these mitigations error rate dropped to ~2% within 3 minutes. Still seeing occasional 502s but much lower. Monitoring for 10m stabilization window.

lee_infra: Restarts complete. No crashloops; memory and CPU look normal. Conn reset rate back down to baseline on two of three nodes.

ana_support: Customers updated. A couple of high-severity tickets escalated to priority; I flagged them for follow-up once stabilized.

jay_runtime: We'll keep the timeout/keepalive and extra replicas for the stabilization window. Need infra to review kernel/TCP settings after incident.

alex_sre: Agreed. Next steps: 1) keep stabilization config for 15m, 2) infra to collect tcpdump from affected nodes and dump `netstat -an`/`ss` outputs, 3) runtime to correlate request ids with gateway logs for `upstream prematurely closed` stack traces, 4) support to track customer tickets. I'll start a follow-up postmortem skeleton after we hand off.

lee_infra: I'll collect the network traces and open an infra ticket with attachments.

pagerduty: Acknowledge. Escalation policy hooked: if error rate >5% for 10m we'll page the on-call for eng-runtime and infra leads.

alex_sre: Error rate holding at ~1.6% for last 4m. Looks stable. We're preparing a handoff to night oncall in 20 minutes.

ana_support: I'll prepare a summary for customers and mark impacted accounts; keeping them informed.

jay_runtime: Logging the exact config deltas applied: `edge.keepalive=75s`, `edge.upstream_timeout=45s`, `gateway.replicas +=2`, `traffic_split: us-east-1->us-west-2 20%`. Pushed change IDs: cfg-1887654330, scale-req-1887654342.

alex_sre: Handoff summary for next oncall (copy paste): "Incident: gateway 502/504 spike in us-east-1. Impact ~7% peak, services downstream healthy. Mitigations applied: scaled gateway +2, restarted 3 edge nodes rolling, increased edge keepalive/timeout, routed 20% traffic to us-west-2. Current status: stabilized to ~1.5% error rate. Pending: infra network traces + runtime log correlation. Follow-up: postmortem + verify rate-limit rollout."

ana_support: Handoff ack. I'll attach customer ticket IDs: #C-4591, #C-4593, #C-4597 to the incident.

lee_infra: Uploaded pcaps and `ss` logs to infra ticket INF-1887654400.

jay_runtime: Added log correlation notes to runtime ticket RUNTIME-1887654410 with sample request ids.

alex_sre: I'm leaving the incident channel. If it regresses above 4% please page me immediately. Tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-infra for the postmortem. :white_check_mark: 

oncall_bot: Incident resolution state: monitoring -> stabilized. Incident will remain open for postmortem collection.

alex_sre: (final) Handoff done at 1887654560.
